overview: The Geode Fields are the crystal heart of Marus Seru.
details: Massive geodes protrude from the fractured plateau, filled with resonance energy. Crystal-born creatures and geomantic constructs roam the fields.
hooks: A giant geode begins emitting dangerous resonance pulses.
Crystal-born creatures migrate toward the Cracked Plain.
A Seru patrol discovers a new geode cavern.
A crystal spire collapses, revealing a resonance core.
